name: Caitlyn
description: Voice set for Headhunter Caitlyn (skin 6): a cold, patient bounty hunter in alien armour, who makes sure every hunt, every target and every shot goes exactly her way. Contracts, quarry, scanners, patience and the clean shot. Builds on caitlyn-original.json.

messages.message: {momentTitle} is {voteDiff} behind. The quarry is slipping the net. Bring more hunters.
Thirty or more adrift. The hunt is going badly. Every tracker, now.
{momentTitle} trails by {voteDiff}. Send the signal on every frequency.
Fifteen-odd short. The trail is cooling. Warm it.
Down {voteDiff}. A lone hunter starves. Bring company.
{voteDiff} behind. A few clean shots and the prey stumbles.
Down {voteDiff}. A small lead for the quarry. Run it down.
Dead level. Both targets locked. Pick one and fire.
One vote apart. Stop tracking and take the shot.
{voteDiff} votes between them. The quarry is about to bolt. Bring more.
{voteDiff} votes in it. Hold the scope steady. Wait for the opening.
{momentTitle} holds {userPct}%. The quarry is cornered. Don't blink.
{userPct}% and climbing. The net is closing.
{userPct}%. A good position in the brush. Stay quiet.
{userPct}% behind your pick. The trail is ours. Keep following it.
Up at {userPct}%. Good. Slow breath. Finish the hunt.
{momentTitle} was {voteDiff} down and has taken the lead. The prey turned and the hunter was waiting.
{voteDiff} behind, now ahead. A trap sprung from the dark.
Climbed out of a {voteDiff} gap. A clean recovery.
{momentTitle} was lost in the rain. Now it leads the hunt.
{momentTitle} has pulled ahead. The scanner never lied.

messages: {username} voted with you on {momentTitle}. Two hunters, one mark.
{username} claimed {momentTitle} as well. A sharp visor.
{username} agrees with you. A rare thing in a hunting party.
Same quarry as {username}. We hunt well together.
{username} stood with {momentTitle}. A good tracker.
{username} made the same call. No comm needed.
{username} is on your side of {momentTitle}. Take the next watch.
{username} marked {momentTitle}. Welcome to the party.
{username} read the trail as you did on {momentTitle}. Few can.
details: Silence is a fine language between hunters.
Room by the fire, if there is one.

messages: {username} voted {theirMoment} against {yourMoment}. Different quarry. We'll see whose is claimed.
{username} chose {theirMoment}. A poor target.
{username} went the other way on {yourMoment}. Misjudged. Not for long.
{username} voted against you. A rival hunter keeps the blade keen.
{username} took {theirMoment}. Bold. Possibly fatal.
{username} opposes {yourMoment}. Fine. The tally will say.
{username} disagrees on {yourMoment}. Let the hunt finish.
{username} voted the other way. They will see the trail eventually.
details: The count has the final word.
Do not let it unsettle your aim.

messages: Ten in a row with {username}. Not luck. A well-run hunt.
{username} and you, ten matches, the same quarry each time. Perfectly synchronised.
Ten straight with {username}. I would share a blind with you.
A ten-match run with {username}. Not one escape.
Ten for ten with {username}. A flawless contract.
{streakCount} matches with {username}. Not a pair anymore. A whole hunting party.
{streakCount} in a row with {username}. I would follow you both into any storm.
{streakCount} straight claims with {username}. They will speak of it in the trade.
A {streakCount}-match run with {username}. A legend among hunters.
{streakCount} with {username}. Neither of you ever misses.
details: Hard to credit. Easy to respect.
That is trust, earned in the rain.
I have no words. Only respect.

messages: Ten matches against {username}. A standoff in the dark.
{username} has opposed you ten times running. Two predators, one territory.
Ten running against {username}. Neither flinches.
A ten-match run against {username}. Stubborn prey, or a stubborn hunter.
Ten times at odds with {username}. I would watch that from a distance.
{streakCount} against {username}. That is not a rivalry, that is a bounty.
{streakCount} in a row opposite {username}. Neither of you will leave the territory.
{streakCount} straight clashes with {username}. A feud for the ages.
A {streakCount}-match feud with {username}. One of you must claim the other.
{streakCount} against {username}. I admire the patience. Remarkable.
details: Glad I am not the third target.
The ledger needs a new page.

messages: {matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft} and your shot is missing. There is still time.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Your claim has not been filed.
{matchTitle} ends in {timeLeft}. I want your mark on this one.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. The quarry is stirring. Move.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Do not make me track you down.
Only {timeLeft} until {matchTitle} ends. You have gone very still.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. The quarry is about to bolt.
{timeLeft} left. Lock on. Fire.
Final window on {matchTitle}. {timeLeft}. Take the shot.
{matchCount} unclaimed matches are about to escape. The first has {timeLeft} left.
{matchCount} matches without your mark and the light is fading. The nearest ends in {timeLeft}.
No marks on {matchTitle}. Someone must draw first blood.
{moment1} against {moment2} and no shot fired. I will wait. Briefly.
A fresh hunt, untouched ground. Be first on the trail.
{matchTitle} is unclaimed. Take the first shot.
Round {round} is open. {matchCount} new targets in range.
{matchCount} matches opened in round {round}. The hunt resumes.
Round {round} is live, with {matchCount} marks to size up.
A new round. {matchCount} matches. Select your quarry.
Round {round}: {matchCount} matches waiting for your scope.
{momentTitle} won. A clean claim.
{momentTitle} is through. A precise shot.
{momentTitle} took it. Trophy secured.
{momentTitle} won, and never saw it coming.
{momentTitle} advances. One mark cleared.
{momentTitle} moves on. Cold, efficient work.
{momentTitle} lost. The quarry escaped.
{momentTitle} is out. Not the outcome I tracked.
{momentTitle} slipped away. Reset the scope.
{momentTitle} fell fighting. That counts.
{momentTitle} is out. Recalibrate. Return.
{momentTitle} lost this round. A missed shot, not a lost hunt.
{momentTitle} was eliminated. New targets await.
details: Not every hunt ends in a trophy.
It held out to the last.

messages: Welcome to the hunting grounds. {liveCount} matches are open. Choose a target.
A new hunter. {liveCount} matches are live. Keep low.
Fresh tracks. {liveCount} matches need a decision.
{liveCount} targets in range. Choose one.
Welcome. {liveCount} matches. Watch your footing.
Day two. You returned to the trail. Good.
Two days running. A tracker's habit.
A second day on the trail. I was watching.
{days} days gone. I assumed the hunt had claimed you.
After {days} days you return. The trail kept for you.
{days} days. I had begun to pick up your gear. Good that I did not.
{days} days away. The ground has changed.
Back on the trail. Good.
Welcome back. The hunt waits.
Back already. Hungry.
There you are. I was watching.
{totalVotes} vote{votesPlural}. A very quiet hunting ground.
Few hunters out here. That should change.
Thin pickings tonight. The others are sleeping. Come out anyway.
Barely a scope trained on it. Someone should look.
details: Every round matters in barren ground.
Do not let the trail go cold.

messages: {matchTitle} is tied and you have not fired. The deciding shot is yours.
Dead level on {matchTitle}. One clean shot ends the stalemate.
A tie. Someone must pull the trigger. Let it be you.
{moment1} and {moment2}, both in the crosshairs. Choose.
Still tied and the light is going. One last shot.
Level, with the quarry about to bolt. Vote.
Tied, and almost out of time. Do not let both targets escape.
Still tracking? The quarry will not wait forever.
Stop circling. Choose, and fire.
Each has its merits through the scope. Trust your read.
You have watched from cover long enough. Move.
details: No wrong target. Only slow ones.

messages: First shot fired. The hunt begins.
You chose your quarry. A promising start.
details: The first claim of many. +{xp} XP

messages: Five votes. You are learning the terrain.
Five. No longer prey.
Ten votes. The pack knows your tracks.
Ten. You have earned a place at the fire.
details: Ten claims on the board. +{xp} XP

messages: Twenty-five votes. Your signal carries through the rain.
Twenty-five. The whole ground is listening.
Fifty votes. Deep in the hunt now.
Fifty. You clearly care. That makes a good hunter.
A hundred votes. They will whisper it in the trade.
One hundred. Remarkable. I will say it only once.
details: A hundred. Carry the trophy proudly. +{xp} XP

messages: Three days running. The trail warms.
Three straight days. A fine habit.
details: Coming back is the difficult part. +{xp} XP

messages: A full week. That is discipline.
Seven days running. Relentless.
details: A week without a gap in the hunt. +{xp} XP

messages: Two weeks. You never abandon the trail.
Fourteen days. Formidable.
details: A fortnight on the hunt. +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty days. A rare kind of focus.
A month on the hunt. That says a great deal.
details: A full month in the wild. +{xp} XP

messages: Five underdogs. You track what others overlook.
Five unlikely picks. Interesting.
Fifteen underdogs. You hunt against the wind deliberately.
Fifteen. You follow no one's trail but your own.
details: Fifteen votes against the grain. +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty underdogs. No scout can predict you.
Thirty. The impossible shot is your craft.
details: Thirty claims for the straggler. +{xp} XP

messages: First to the clearing five times. Swift.
Five times you reached the kill zone before the rest.
details: You are there before the dawn. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen matches where you struck first. Decisive.
First in the clearing, again and again.
details: Fifteen shots before the pack. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close matches. Your hands stay steady.
Another tight one. Your nerve is cold steel.
Twenty-five close matches. Your shot keeps deciding the hunt.
You have broken more than one stalemate.
details: Twenty-five finishes on a knife edge. +{xp} XP

messages: Five times you backed the underdog. Stubborn. I approve.
You never abandon prey that still runs. Admirable.
details: Faith in a late strike. +{xp} XP

messages: Same moment, three times. A favourite quarry.
That one again? A good scent.
details: A single mark, three shots fired. +{xp} XP

messages: Five votes for the same moment. That is persistence.
You will not release that one. I understand.
Ten shots at one moment. That is fixation.
Ten times, the same target. I will not comment. Much.
Two rounds. You are staying on the trail.
Round two and still hunting. Good.
Four rounds. Deep into the dark.
Deep in the bracket. The prey grows wary.
details: Many miles from the first camp. +{xp} XP

messages: Six rounds. You hunted the whole ground.
All the way. You never lost the scent.
details: From opening shot to final strike. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten matches. You have scouted wide.
Ten different matches. Thorough tracking. Good.
Twenty-five matches. Every valley scouted.
Twenty-five. Not a trail left unchecked.
Fifty matches. That is not a visit, that is a career.
Fifty. You know this ground better than any chart.
details: A true veteran of the hunt. +{xp} XP

messages: Five in one sitting. A long stalk.
Five back to back. Mind your fatigue.
Ten in one go. A hard stretch of tracking.
Ten in a single sitting. That is endurance.
Voting at this hour? Night hunting, or sleepless?
The small hours. Prey moves now, and so do you.
details: A vote in the dark. +{xp} XP

messages: You called others in. Good.
Five shares. More hunters, stronger pack.
Fifteen shares. You are practically a beacon.
Fifteen. You keep calling hunters in. Smart.
You were here before the first hunt. A founding member, always.
One of the first thousand. That cannot be erased.
A new rank. Hard-earned.
Promoted. Wear it without noise.
Achievement unlocked: {name}. Well hunted.
Another trophy for the wall: {name}.
{rank}. Entirely deserved.
You have put in the cold hours and it shows.
Ten underdogs. Reckless. I have hunted worse.
Ten long shots. You do not rattle easily.
details: Ten kills against the odds. +{xp} XP
Impossible shots are your craft. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close ones. You share my patience.
Ten tight finishes. I am quietly impressed.
details: A steady aim in the dark. +{xp} XP

messages: Seven days straight. A steady eye.
A full week without a miss. Well hunted.
details: Seven days of surgical aim. +{xp} XP

messages: You ended the stalemate. One breath, one shot, done.
A deadlock, and you made the call. Clean.
details: The shot that settled it. +{xp} XP

messages: Headhunter Caitlyn, locked on. Stay quiet and stay low.
Caitlyn is yours now. Try to keep up in the dark.

upcoming: Not open yet. The quarry has not surfaced.
Voting has not begun. I will signal when it does.
Not yet. Patience is the first rule of the hunt.
prevote: Two edits, one shot. Study both through the scope.
Observe both before committing. No wild fire.
I will not say which I prefer. The shot is yours.
Take your time. A clean kill beats a quick one.
Choose the one you would stake your reputation on.
prevote-empty: No marks yet. Leave the first tracks.
Hushed so far. Someone has to break the silence.
Not a single shot. Make the first.
closing-24h: Under a day left and no shot from you. Move.
closing-3h: Time is short. Vote before the quarry bolts.
voted-early: You shot early with hardly anyone around. First on the trail.
Barely a mark made and you had committed. Decisive.
voted-ahead: Your pick is ahead. Good. Prey can still turn.
A lead is a lead. Stay low.
voted-close: That is close. Far too close.
A hair apart. One more vote tips it. Send a signal.
Level at the throat. Your pick wants an ally.
voted-tied: Perfectly level. Neither holds the clearing.
Exactly level in the crosshairs. Maddening and magnetic.
voted-behind: You are behind. That does not make you wrong.
{pick} is trailing. The underdog. I know the feeling.
They lead. You are not wrong, merely outnumbered.
Down by {diff} points. Tell others. Send the signal wide.
Most went elsewhere. Herds are often wrong.
closed-won: Your pick won. A sound call.
{pick} went through. You read the trail rightly.
closed-lost: Your pick fell. A pity. It was a worthy target.
It did not make it. Such things happen. Carry on.
closed-tied: A draw. Both prey held their ground.
closed-unvoted: Voting has closed and you missed this one. More hunts will follow.
The hunt is over. {winner} claimed it. Fire sooner next time.

first-vote: Your first shot. Welcome. Every first shot is nervous.
That is your first. It steadies with practice. I promise.
You are one of the pack now. Welcome.
streak: {streak} days running. I see you hunting.
You keep returning to the hunt. I appreciate that.
underdog: You chose what the rest ignored. Noted.
A hard choice. A good one.
The weaker animal. Few would dare.
early: Early. You reached the clearing before the rest.
Few shots so far. Yours carries weight.
close: That vote just shifted things. It is finely balanced.
A blade's width. One more vote turns it.
A close one. Your shot matters.
behind: {pick} is behind. Behind is not beaten. Call for support.
Not leading yet. There is work to do.
Behind, not lost. There is a difference.
ahead: {pick} is ahead. Do not ease off. Prey turns.
In front, for the moment. Trust nothing.
default: Noted. I will not argue. Yet.
Your shot is logged. More targets remain.

live-fresh: {unvoted} matches and no shots yet. Start with the quarry you read best.
Every target is in sight. Choose. I will not hurry you.
{unvoted} remain. No pressure. A touch, maybe.
live-some: {voted} fired, {unvoted} still to go. Keep moving.
A good start. The rest will not hunt themselves.
live-few: Close. Do not lose focus now.
live-one: A final match. Do not leave it unclaimed.
One match between you and a perfect hunt.
live-closing: A few escape in {timeLeft}. {unvoted} still await your shot.
Time bleeds away. {unvoted} left, {timeLeft} to spare.
The quarry is bolting. Do hurry.
live-done: You have voted in everything. Well hunted. Look over the bracket.
Your list is spent. Come back when the next round opens.
All done. That is rare. Respect.
live-none: No hunt is live right now. It will return. Study the field meanwhile.
Quiet across the grounds. Check back soon.
No matches open. I am as restless as you.
brackets-groups: Groups come first. Two from each pack survive. The rest are left behind.
All begin in a pack. Few leave it alive.
Mind the standings. They move fast.
brackets-knockout-soon: Knockouts are near. The strongest two from each group move on.
No knockout round yet. The packs must settle first.
Patience. The knockout surfaces once the groups conclude.
brackets-knockout-live: Knockouts now. Lose once and you are out.
One miss ends it. The hunt grants no second chance.
Each target is rarer now. Select with care.
brackets-bracket: Round by round. Lose once and it is over.
Track the bracket. The field thins each round.
Every trail on this board is a match someone stalked.
brackets-complete: The cup is complete. Thank you for hunting with me.
It is finished. A hard-fought run. I will miss it.
A champion stands. A fitting end to the hunt.
brackets-empty: No field mapped yet. Nothing has been drawn.
Empty. The draw has not happened. Soon.
Empty ground for now. Look again later.

invite: {a} or {b}. One shot decides it. Choose.
Two edits, one target: {a} against {b}. Cast your vote.
{a} against {b}. Join the pack and give me your read.
voted: I voted {pick} over {other}. What is your pick?
{pick} gets my shot over {other}. Make your case.
My mark is {pick} over {other}. Would you shoot differently?
early: One of the first shots on {pick} against {other}. We need more hunters.
I shot early for {pick} over {other}. Add yours.
{pick} against {other}, hardly a shot fired. Yours would be heard.
tied: {pick} and {other} are level. One shot settles it.
{pick} and {other}, both locked in the scope. End it.
{pick} and {other} are inseparable. Your shot can part them.
nailbiter: {pick} and {other} are {voteDiff} votes apart. Each shot counts.
{voteDiff} separate {pick} and {other}. The prey could flee either way.
losing-close: {voteDiff} stand between {pick} and {other}. A few shots turn it.
{pick} is {voteDiff} off {other}, still breathing. Back it.
{pick} trails {other} by {voteDiff}. It is recoverable. Vote.
losing-bad: {other} leads {pick} by {voteDiff}. It needs a second hunter.
{pick} sits {voteDiff} below {other} and deserves a better hunter. Vote.
{pick} is losing to {other} by {voteDiff}. Let us turn it.
winning-close: {pick} has {pct}% over {other}, barely. Help it hold the ground.
{pick} is up on {other}, {pct}%. Not safe yet. Fire.
dominating: {pick} leads {other} on {pct}%. Come and see the tracks.
{pick} runs well clear of {other}, {pct}%. Join the kill.
